# dependencies/ffmpeg/

FFmpeg binaries go here. Gitignored - not committed.

**Recommended:** Clone [ffkit](https://github.com/DavoDC/ffkit) alongside this repo. CoverVidMaker auto-detects `../ffkit/dependencies/ffmpeg/` and uses it - nothing needed here.

**Standalone (no ffkit):** Download from https://github.com/GyanD/codexffmpeg/releases and place `ffmpeg.exe`, `ffprobe.exe`, and `ffplay.exe` in this folder.
